_doc: The default file with 9 s between thoughts instead of 4 (2026-11-20). With the publication grace of v3.1 §1.6 ter an answer lands 3–5 s after the close plus the model: a stream whose next thought starts 4 s after the last is a person who did not wait for the answer, and the open-loop stream cannot wait for it. 9 s is past the non-terminal grace plus a slow model, so what is measured is the ear, not the open loop. Every flow carries the tag.

human_pause._measured: Checked against the human profile's es voice pause_between_fragments_ms (n=1643): p50 1744, p90 4993, p99 18251 ms. This log-normal through p50 1700 / p90 5000 matches p50 and p90 within 3 %; its p99 is ~12 s (shorter tail). EN (n=38, low_n) is not used: the profile says to prefer es.

_cells: each pause length is a cell; 300 ms is reported but, per the profile, lives inside a final
